records.text: A shave biopsy specimen demonstrated a diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells admixed with rare eosinophils, uniformly positive for CD207/langerin and negative for myeloperoxidase. BRAF-V600E variant status was identified through immunohistochemical studies and confirmed by polymerase chain reaction analysis.

bindings.label: A 63-year-old man with medical history of chronic high-grade myelodysplastic syndrome and refractory anemia with excess blasts
Physical examination revealed a 3×2-mm smooth, red, dome-shaped papule under the right lower eyelid
Infectious skin lesion in immunocompromised host
Skin biopsy shows a diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid cells with rare eosinophils
Immunohistochemistry shows the infiltrate is uniformly CD207/langerin-positive and myeloperoxidase-negative
Molecular testing detects BRAF-V600E mutation in the lesion
The facial lesion is cutaneous Langerhans cell histiocytosis
